credit_line: Gift of The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation
description: Graphite sketch of a landscape. Simple line drawing, no shading. Composition composed of a large hill on the right which extends down and across the width of the paper, this movement is mimicked by a smaller hill behind the large one. In the distance the horizon is visible.
title: Untitled (Palo Duro Canyon)
